title: New group
purpose: Add a first-level group that categories are placed in.
summary: Add a group to hold related categories, such as the ones for billing questions. A group has a name and an optional client label. Only the admin role can open this form.

tasks.title: Add a group
steps: Select [[Create group]]. The list opens at the new group, ready for its categories.

tasks.title: Give clients different wording
steps: Type the wording in [[Client label]] and save.

good_to_know: A group is not a category. Tickets are filed under categories, so add at least one category before using the group.
The key cannot be changed after creation. Leave it empty to make one from the name.
Groups sit at the first level only. A group cannot be placed inside another group.
A new group is active and goes to the end of the list. Reorder it from the list.

items.label: Group name
items.description: Required, up to 120 characters. Surrounding spaces are removed.

items.label: Key
items.description: Optional, letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, up to 60 characters. Empty means one is made from the name. It must be unused by any other group or category and never changes after creation.

items.label: Client label
items.description: Optional, up to 120 characters. The wording for client portal users; empty means the staff name.

items.label: Create group
items.description: Saves the group as active at the end of the group list and records who created it. The list opens at the new group with a confirmation.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to Ticket categories without saving.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: A key already in use, or a name another group already has (ignoring capital letters), is refused with a message on the form. What you typed stays.
